interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a safe pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add curb extensions at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve pedestrian visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install dedicated lighting fixtures under the elevated structure to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians at night.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a median island to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians crossing the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade existing markings to high-visibility continental or ladder patterns to increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the crossing to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility by bringing pedestrians past the columns and parked cars.

interventions.title: Under-deck Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install high-intensity lighting on the underside of the elevated structure specifically targeting the crosswalk and sidewalk areas.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles receive a green light, increasing their visibility in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Activated Warning Systems
interventions.description: Install Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFBs) to alert drivers when a pedestrian is crossing, especially important given the visual obstructions.

interventions.title: Enhanced Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install additional, pedestrian-scale lighting under the structure to improve visibility and perceived safety.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk where possible and use curb extensions at intersections to reduce crossing distances and improve visibility around the structural columns.

interventions.title: Improved Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale lighting underneath the elevated structure to improve visibility and security in the shadowed areas.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Add physical separation between the bike lane and the travel lane, which also provides an additional buffer for pedestrians on the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Curb Management and Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Install continuous curbing with clearly defined, narrow driveway entrances to reduce the number of conflict points and protect the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks and Pedestrian Refuge
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility paint and consider a median refuge island to shorten the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffering and Street Trees
interventions.description: Add a furniture zone or planting strip with street trees to provide physical and psychological separation between pedestrians and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Under-Deck Lighting
interventions.description: Install high-intensity, pedestrian-scale lighting attached to the underside of the elevated structure to eliminate dark spots and improve security.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Sidewalk Definition
interventions.description: Narrow the vehicle access points to the parking lot and use different paving materials or markings to clearly define the pedestrian walkway through the conflict zone.

interventions.title: Midblock Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk, potentially with a pedestrian refuge island and RRFBs (Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons).

interventions.title: Enhanced Under-Structure Lighting
interventions.description: Improve lighting levels beneath the elevated structure to increase pedestrian visibility and perceived safety.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Provide designated, high-visibility crossing points to alert drivers to pedestrian presence.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the sidewalk to provide a smooth, continuous walking surface.

interventions.title: Bollards or Curbing
interventions.description: Install physical barriers to clearly delineate the pedestrian walkway from the vehicle access points and parking areas.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Installation
interventions.description: Install a furniture zone or planting strip between the curb and the sidewalk to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Improved Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale lighting underneath the elevated structure to improve visibility and perceived safety.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffers
interventions.description: Install physical buffers or bollards between the sidewalk and the gas station lot to better define the pedestrian zone.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Delineation
interventions.description: Use paint, bollards, or different paving materials to clearly define the pedestrian path across the gas station apron.

interventions.title: Sanitation Management
interventions.description: Implement regular trash collection or provide designated bins to prevent debris from obstructing the walkway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install supplemental lighting under the elevated structure to improve visibility and personal security.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffers/Bollards
interventions.description: Install bollards or a small furniture zone where space permits to provide a physical barrier between pedestrians and moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Lane Restriping and Narrowing
interventions.description: Clearly mark travel lanes and reduce their width to encourage slower driving speeds and provide space for buffers.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the gas station driveway to the minimum necessary for safe vehicle access, clearly defining the pedestrian path with different materials or markings.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility markings and potentially a pedestrian-activated signal to facilitate safe crossing of the roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and pedestrian warning signs to provide a designated crossing location.

interventions.title: Raised Sidewalk Crossing
interventions.description: Continue the sidewalk at its current grade across the driveway to slow vehicles and reinforce pedestrian priority.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the driveway entrance to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and slow turning traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Paint a high-visibility crosswalk across the driveway to clearly define the pedestrian path and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a buffer zone with bollards or planters to separate the walkway from the roadway.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalk across Driveway
interventions.description: Paint high-visibility crosswalk markings across the driveway to define the pedestrian path and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing / Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the driveway opening to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Tactile Warning Strips
interventions.description: Install truncated domes at the edges of the driveway to assist visually impaired pedestrians.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lanes
interventions.description: Install physical separation (e.g., bollards or curbs) for the existing bike lanes to provide a buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic.
